warnings.message: Clock gating is assumed: idle cycles of 3 logic component(s) cost leakage only.
warnings.explain: NPUWattch assumes that each block is clock-gated, thus an idle cycle costs no dynamic energy. A register-file or FIFO access costs its mode energy minus the idle energy, because a gated array clocks only the accessed row. A datapath event is one active cycle and costs its full energy. To model a block without clock gating, set clock_gating: false on its component.

notes.explain: NPUWattch reads the word width from `width`, the entry count from `depth`, and the bank count from `n_banks`. The attributes in this message have no NPUWattch attribute with the same meaning, so they do not change the result. No action is necessary.

notes.message: system_top_level.nvdla.sdp: the user component library entry 'nvdla_sdp' gives the cost, not the class 'dummy_storage'.
notes.explain: The user_component attribute of the component names the library entry. NPUWattch uses the entry for the area and the energy. Timeloop uses the class of the component.

notes.message: system_top_level.nvdla.cbuf (sram): depth 8192 is the total of 16 banks, so mem_depth_per_bank is 512 (64 KB total).
notes.explain: In Accelergy, the depth is the total for all banks. NPUWattch divides it by the number of banks.
